command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
$name = 'WilliamOS-MIG-997-FetchOllama'
$t = Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName $name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$i = Get-ScheduledTaskInfo -TaskName $name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Write-Output "state=$($t.State) last_result=$($i.LastTaskResult) last_run=$($i.LastRunTime)"
Write-Output '--- FETCH-LOG ---'
Get-Content 'D:\HermesServices\ollama\_install\fetch.log' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Write-Output '--- STAGE-DIR ---'
Get-ChildItem 'D:\HermesServices\ollama\_install' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name, Length, LastWriteTimeUtc | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 120
Write-Output '--- DIST ---'
Write-Output "dist_exists=$(Test-Path 'D:\HermesServices\ollama\dist')"
Get-ChildItem 'D:\HermesServices\ollama\dist' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name, Mode, Length | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 120
Write-Output "d_free_gb=$([math]::Round((Get-Volume -DriveLetter D).SizeRemaining / 1GB, 2))"
Write-Output '--- RC ---'
